card.name: Narrative verbs of time passing
card.fires_on: Verbs or words in story-like prose that describe growth, passing time or a developing situation, such as "grew", "passed" or "occurred". The next words often tell what happened after or until a point.

modes.label: Growth or time passing
modes.description: A verb saying something grew or time went by in a narrative, where a result or turning point follows.
modes.example: As David’s popularity<< grew>>, Saul’s paranoia increased, until David
